embedded_source_git_identity.qualification: Source archive has no Git checkout; external commit/archive/source-byte audit supplies identity without rewriting generated manifest

limitations: One fixed scenario and one fresh Windows/Python profile only.
This is not an unmodified baseline installation; the packaging overlay and external locks are explicit inputs.
No repeated-run, container resource, browser, WebGL, deployment or public-access checks were run.
No cross-platform PNG/TIFF byte-identity guarantee is made.

packaging_overlay.scope: Existing patched package metadata only; scientific Python files unchanged

archived-package-install.log.sanitization: Workspace, repository and user-profile filesystem prefixes replaced; original local logs retained outside repository
